name: kxhormuzweekly
title: Will traffic through the Strait of Hormuz exceed 22 transit calls from Oct 12 to Oct 18, 2026?
settlement: Resolves Yes if the number of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz reported by IMF PortWatch, summed daily from Oct 12, 2026 to Oct 18, 2026, is above 22. The market resolves no earlier than Tuesday at 9 AM after the period ends, once complete data is available.
decideContext: Estimate how the news changes the total number of IMF PortWatch transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz summed over Oct 12-18, 2026. The market resolves Yes if that weekly sum is above the strike (strikes range from 22 to 75).
